author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! GTA 6 is one of the most hyped games in existence and asides from not being able to own the game ever and having it priced higher that usual, we have not seen a single bit of any gameplay and it's already August. I'm a bit worried about the game, the state it's in, what comes after it and how well it might even run. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: I'm Worried About GTA 6 And Rockstar Games...
